failures.description: cloudbench-controller environment step: intermittent live GitHub API check in the token resolver
failures.evidence: Focused run at 4b79be50e (load ~2): only step environment failed, 'resolve_github_token returned empty despite available controller credentials'. The resolver validates each candidate via a live api.github.com call (GitHub returned HTTP 503 and rate-limit errors to this user earlier in the deploy). The identical step passes twice in the same worker under the same env -i environment minutes later (/var/tmp/webdecoy-rca/worker-env-test-1.log, -2.log: rc=0), and the full gate passes in isolation (/var/tmp/webdecoy-rca/branch-cloudbench.log GATE_RESULT exit=0). Worker agents/.env and back-end/.env are byte-identical to the coordinator's. This diff touches no cloudbench or GitHub-token code.
failures.assigned_reason: Deploy owner keeps this repair: rerun the unchanged gate; no waiver
